title: Chromová kola pro BMW M2 Competition

notes: Ten separate actual windows follow the photographed chrome spoke edges and outer front-lip boundary. The patterned workshop wall and visible rear barrel inside each window are not mistaken for front metal.
Five individual visible lug bores follow their photographed inner boundaries. No generic spoke or aperture template was substituted.
The bottom tyre valve is visible on the rear barrel within a main window; it is not an additional overlapping through-hole in the front face.
Geometry and texture use the identical actual photo-front source and ellipse. Depth, back and perspective rectification are visual estimates.

At two upper front-lip ends the native chrome edge is only a few pixels wide. Those observed aperture endpoints retain a small metal bridge inside the bead-seat border, preventing raster contact with the exterior.
